producer_report.summary: I wrote docs/design/reviews/native-pr-landing-review-3.md, in review 2's format. I changed no other file. Its verdict is accept with changes, and it states that it was written independently. Review 2's findings F1-F6 and F8 are resolved in the revised design. F7 is resolved only in part: the design still marks the run.rs and invariant.rs line numbers as unchecked, though I checked them and they are right. F3 is resolved in the design text, but the roadmap order is still unchanged. I found no High finding. The review adds four new Medium findings and one Low finding. N1: the merged-content check does not say how a diff is compared with a fingerprint, and does not say what state a merged-but-refused job is left in. N2: owned mode cannot store the pull request number in the job's own records, because the number exists only after the records are committed. N3: the stealth pull request body and branch name can still name the job. N4: in stealth mode, a squash of several jobs is checked only against the last job. N5 is wording. I cited file and line for each claim, and I labelled claims read, design, reported or unchecked. I ran no commands and none of the cargo checks, since the change is one markdown file.

checks_run.note: Not run: the only change is one new markdown file.

open_issues: The deliverables list names docs/design/native-pr-landing.md and CHANGELOG.md as 'modify'. Acceptance criterion 4 and the out-of-scope list say the design is untouched and only the new review changes. I followed the criteria and edited neither file. If a CHANGELOG entry is wanted, it needs a separate edit.
The design's status line 4 still says 'Not yet re-reviewed'. I did not change it, because the design is not edited.
The roadmap order (F3) is still open and belongs to a separate job.
mistakes: N5's first bullet, about path style, is a weak finding that does not need to be in the review.
I did not read the fingerprint definition, so N1 says only that the design does not say how a diff is compared with a fingerprint.
learnings: The design is at docs/design/native-pr-landing.md, and review 2's format is in docs/design/reviews/native-pr-landing-review-2.md.
The cited line numbers in the design (invariant.rs 225-252, 267-272, 297-303; run.rs 1113, 1373, 1401; BRIEF.md 459-466; athena-v0.md 1446-1449; athena-v0-review-1.md 626-627) all match the files.
The roadmap still lists the parallel pool before native PR landing (roadmap.md lines 33-38).
